story.biography: Mr August Jonsson is 18, a dock labourer, from Jönköping. He sailed third class from Southampton, bound for Brooklyn: going to be married. He travels alone. His share of the ticket came to £8. He speaks Swedish and no English. At home in Jönköping his mother, Agnes Jonsson, thinks of him often. Those who know him would call him a worrier and musical.
wishes: to marry and have a home

goals.text: Write to his aunt in Brooklyn before we land

secrets: has sewn the savings into a coat lining and checks it every night
